# TASK-9999 — Fixture record (one section per violating module)

Spans and instruments the fixture modules are specified to emit:

- `undocumented.widget.create`
- `stale.widget.create`
- `nosection.widget.create`
- `retired.widget.create`, `retired.widget.archive`
- `orphan.widget.create`
- `short.widget.create`, `short.widget.archive`

`unspecified` deliberately has no entry here: its README declares a name this record never names.
